mission.title: Detection
mission.description: Field-test a new scanning routine against the General's hidden Elite Commandos.

npc.say: Buona fortuna! Agent Gray will give you further details once you have led your assistants outside.
Your progress will be monitored closely. This opportunity must not be squandered.

The commando program self-terminated after capture. However, we were able to keep its routines active long enough to extract the necessary data and benchmarking parameters relating to the properties of its battle suit.
Programs operating outside the bounds of the System must be deleted. Toleration leads only to further abuse.

You may have heard that another "Morpheus" sighting was reported recently. You can be sure that we are looking into this matter very closely. Obviously, it cannot be the former Zion leader, as he was confirmed terminated by the Assassin program some time ago.

Do not allow rumors to impair your efficiency, operative. The System will supply you with all the data you require to carry out your function.
Your operator's emotional responses are increasingly counterproductive.

Lieutenant, the Machines may have a means of detecting you. Abort the operation immediately.
I repeat, abort immediately. Do not risk an engagement.

phase.briefing:
{player}, study of the Elite Commando our operatives captured in the field has enabled us to develop a scanning routine to detect their presence, circumventing the detection jamming technology in their battle suits.
This scanning routine requires a field test. Rendezvous with Agent Pace. She will allocate several combat subroutines to assist you.

enter.say: You know how some people--mostly delusional Zionites, I guess--say Pace is actually Trinity? I wonder if we can get her to start wearing black leather.

talk.say: Saluti, {player}! Nicholas Hassam and Hipolito Giddings are yours to command for this mission. They will assist you in fighting the General's Elite Commando programs.

done.say:
I'm definitely seeing the leather thing working for her...
By...which I mean, corral those two and bring them outside.

objective.text: Lead Nicholas Hassam and Hipolito Giddings out of the area

phase.briefing:
The scanning routine will run through your broadcast signal. Your operator will monitor the power flow, and the resulting readings. This scan requires a significant amount of power. Therefore, the test must be completed as quickly as possible.
The marked location was revealed as a commando access point by scans of their network. Proceed to the location. The scan will commence once you are in range of the target.

enter.say:
Geez, they'd better not blow something out on this crate with all the data they're blasting through here. Well, here goes...
Okay... I'm... Uh... Damn it! I'm getting something, but there's too much feedback. There are definitely Elite Commandos in there, though, if the code profile the Machines gave me is accurate.
I'll see if I can tweak the scan settings to clear the feedback. You'd better go ahead and handle those commandos.

objective.text: Kill all of the Elite Commandos

done.say:
Wait, I'm getting something... Ohhh, snap.
There were more of them there--I can see them scattering now...sort of. Damn it, if the Machines would actually get this stuff right we could do our job!

phase.briefing:
The necessity of fine-tuning the scan routine was expected, {player}. That is, after all, the purpose of your present task.
Adjustments are being made. Acquire additional support programs from Agent Pace, and prepare for a second trial of the detection system.

enter.say: We get to see Pace twice in one day? Okay, that totally makes up for them borking the scan routine.

talk.say: Ah, hello again, tesoro! I have your programs ready for you!

done.say: Get those two outdoors. The Machines had better have the kinks worked out their scan routine by now...

objective.text: Lead the Combat Subroutines out of the area

phase.briefing: Adjustments to the scan routine are complete. Proceed to the access node target, {player}.

enter.say:
Here goes nothing...
It's running... I'm getting something... I think I see a one or two in there... It's still a bit fuzzy. I'll see if I can make some adjustments...

done.say: The General can't have many of those nodes left at the rate we're taking them out.

objective.text: Kill all of the Elite Commandos

done.say:
Code scan's clean...
Yeah! We did it! I could see them all, crisp and clear. Man, that was satisfying. You don't know how much not being able to see those guys has been bugging me. Now, I wonder if I can get ol' Pace to hook us up with full-time scan routine access...

mission.finish:
Thank you for your report, operative.
It appears that the scan routine is now performing as required. While the energy consumption of the scan is such that we cannot afford to run it constantly, we will be able to utilize it to detect the General's Elite forces when the situation requires it.
You may now return to your regular duties.
